summary: Iteration 11 (bugfix testing) — BOTH bug fixes verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest PASSED on live preview URL. Frontend: mobile viewport (390x844) UI smoke fully green after in-app navigation. BUG 1 (Floating cart bar on category screen): logged in as quick-user (+355695808480/123456), navigated Home → tapped 'Snacks' category → /category/snacks shows the orange 'floating-cart-bar' at the bottom (x=20,y=766,w=350,h=62) with badge='2 items', label='View cart', subtotal='1760 L' and forward arrow; tapping the bar navigates to /cart which loads the expected 'Your cart' screen with the Mtr Mutter Paneer-RTE line item at 1760 L. FloatingCartBar auto-hides when cart is empty (confirmed via cartCount guard in code). BUG 2 (Map picker locate button + auto-locate): GET /api/geo/map-picker HTML contains all required tokens — 'locate-btn', 'requestLocation', "gestureHandling: 'greedy'", 'fly-to', 'request-locate', 'getCurrentPosition', 600ms auto-locate delay, aria-label='Use my location'. On the live /address-picker screen the map iframe renders the Google Map centered on Tirana with the round white locate button visible bottom-right (bounding-box {x:330,y:627,w:48,h:48}), no fatal error overlay, hint='Drag the map to place the pin'. Clicking the locate button does not crash the map — className stays 'locate-btn' (headless browser silently denies OS geolocation, which is expected per agent-to-agent note). Injecting a fly-to postMessage into the iframe also doesn't error. Regression: /api/health, /api/categories (returns 4+ cats incl. snacks/rtc/rte/noodles), /api/products?category=snacks (33 items), /api/offers/banners, /api/geo/autocomplete, /api/geo/reverse-geocode (Tirana serviceable=true, Paris serviceable=false), /api/auth/login (quick user), /api/cart POST+GET (subtotal_lek/subtotal_eur returned as FloatingCartBar expects) — all green. Deprecated packages detected: none new (expo-location v19 used correctly, no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports). Only pre-existing warnings: shadow* style props deprecation and pointerEvents prop deprecation on the FloatingCartBar wrap View (see minor).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. The wrap View uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop. On modern React Native this should be moved to style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}. Cosmetic only — component still works.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Unchanged from previous iterations — not introduced by this bug-fix.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Move `pointerEvents="box-none"` from prop to style on the FloatingCartBar wrap View in /app/frontend/src/components/floating-cart-bar.tsx line 58 to clear the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/geo.py:161-355 map-picker HTML — clean impl. Auto-locate delayed by 600ms after gm_ready so map is fully instantiated before geolocation prompt fires; requestLocation properly toggles spinner state and resets to 'idle' on error so the button remains clickable for retry (matches spec). Uses navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition with enableHighAccuracy=true + timeout=10000 — appropriate for a location picker. Also correctly handles two postMessage types ('fly-to' and 'request-locate') for host-driven control.

floating-cart-bar.tsx:29-53 — useEffect correctly re-fetches /cart totals when cartCount or token changes; guards against setState on unmount via `cancelled` flag; hides component when cartCount<=0. subtotal is displayed via formatPrice(...) so LEK/EUR currency toggle is respected. Nicely encapsulated.
category/[slug].tsx:125 — FloatingCartBar mounted with bottomInset=16; FlatList content padding-bottom is 120 (line 98) so items never sit under the bar. Good spacing.

address-picker.tsx:19,108-119 — WebView correctly configured with geolocationEnabled + originWhitelist=['*']; native uses expo-location primer with getForegroundPermissionsAsync + requestForegroundPermissionsAsync + getCurrentPositionAsync (Balanced accuracy) and posts fly-to with zoom=17. Silent-denial handling correct.

app.json (per problem statement) — declares NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES — required for a production build to prompt correctly. (Not verified against native build; verified only via file reference in prompt.)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (FloatingCartBar visibility + tap-to-cart navigation working; address-picker map + locate button + fly-to postMessage all functional)

seed_data_creation: Reused quick-user cart from previous iteration state (2 x Mtr Mutter Paneer-RTE = 1760 L). No new seed data created; test did not clean the cart (left as-is for subsequent runs — non-destructive). Test file uses TEST_ prefixing convention where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_bugfix_iter11.py -v`. All 13 tests pass in ~2s. UI smoke: log in via Home flow (not direct goto to a nested route) so useApp context hydrates the cart before rendering FloatingCartBar. Direct goto('/category/...') from a fresh page will show cartCount=0 for ~1-2s until GET /cart resolves — the bar then appears. Address-picker locate button: headless browsers cannot grant OS location; verify presence + non-crash on click rather than actual fly-to. Fly-to via postMessage from host is exercisable and works.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — both reported bugs are fixed and verified. Bug 1 (missing cart access on category screen) is resolved by mounting FloatingCartBar in /app/frontend/app/category/[slug].tsx; Bug 2 (no auto-zoom + no recenter) is resolved by (a) backend HTML now auto-calls navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition 600ms after map load and (b) frontend primes expo-location on mount and sends a fly-to postMessage at zoom 17.
